concerns.text: Task T021 is tagged `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but it depends on the output of T029 (`ResourceMonitor`) – it parses the `/usr/bin/time` log generated by the monitor. This creates a hidden ordering dependency, so T021 cannot safely run in parallel with other `[P]` tasks.

Task T028 is also marked `[P]` yet it aggregates `results/monitoring.csv` rows produced by T029 (and potentially T021). Because it reads the same file that other `[P]` tasks write, concurrent execution could cause race conditions; the `[P]` tag is therefore unsafe.
